# T-1: Model draft artifacts

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Define draft review, draft triage, and draft repair JSON artifact contracts with validation helpers and dedicated value classes where production code represents artifact behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Review, triage, and repair artifact schemas are represented in production validation code.
- Artifact validation rejects missing phase/source links, invalid decisions, and count mismatches.
- The artifact model does not parse markdown reports for machine decisions.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer colocating draft artifact validation near existing spec repair validation or extracting a shared helper only where two concrete call sites need it.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests validate accepted and rejected review/triage/repair artifact shapes.
